rationale: C01, issued only nine days earlier, is essentially the same directive with the carrier and employee representative substituted. It reproduces the child's full recital sequence, the same finding that the dispute threatens to deprive “a section of the country” of essential transportation service, the same thirty-day reporting requirement, and the same section 10 status-quo mechanism. C16 and C12 are nearly as close, but C01 is the strongest recent template match.

shared_material.child_excerpt: WHEREAS, a dispute exists between the Braniff Airways, Inc., a carrier, and certain of its employees represented by the Brotherhood of Railway & Steamship Clerks, Freight Handlers, Express and Station Employees, a labor organization
shared_material.parent_excerpt: WHEREAS a dispute exists between the Toledo, Lorain & Fairport Dock Company, a carrier, and certain of its employees represented by the International Longshoremen's Association, A.F. of L., a labor organization
shared_material.explanation: The opening recital uses the same sentence structure and roles, substituting only the carrier and labor organization.

shared_material.child_excerpt: WHEREAS this dispute has not heretofore been adjusted under the provisions of the Railway Labor Act, as amended; and WHEREAS this dispute, in the judgment of the national Mediation Board, threatens substantially to interrupt interstate commerce to a degree such as to deprive a section of the country of essential transportation service
shared_material.parent_excerpt: WHEREAS this dispute has not heretofore been adjusted under the provisions of the Railway Labor Act, as amended; and WHEREAS this dispute, in the judgment of the National Mediation Board, threatens substantially to interrupt interstate commerce to a degree such as to deprive a section of the country of essential transportation service
shared_material.explanation: The two substantive predicate recitals are virtually verbatim, including the same geographic-impact formulation.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The board shall report its findings to the President with respect to the said dispute within thirty days from the date of this order.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The board shall report its findings to the President with respect to the said dispute within thirty days from the date of this order.

shared_material.child_excerpt: As provided by section 10 of the Railway Labor Act, as amended, from this date and for thirty days after the board has made its report to the President, no change, except by agreement, shall be made by the Braniff Airways, Inc., or its employees in the conditions out of which the said dispute arose.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: As provided by section 10 of the Railway Labor Act, as amended, from this date and for thirty days after the board has made its report to the President, no change, except by agreement, shall be made by the Toledo, Lorain & Fairport Dock Company or its employees in the conditions out of which the said dispute arose.
shared_material.explanation: The operative status-quo machinery is copied verbatim apart from the carrier name and incidental punctuation.
